annotations.description: Selects the 'Razorpay' Payment Method on the Storefront Checkout Payment page.

Clicks the 'Pay with Razorpay' button. This triggers preparePayment() -> placeOrder() in razorpay-method.js, which places the real Magento order via the standard checkout placeOrder action, then automatically POSTs to razorpay/payment/order (Controller/Payment/Order::execute()) to create the matching razorpay_sales_order (OrderLink) row -- both of these are real, assertable DB writes that happen before any further interaction. Immediately after that AJAX call resolves, the JS opens Razorpay's own hosted checkout.js modal (an external, third-party iframe outside this module's DOM) to collect card/UPI/etc. details. MFTF cannot reliably drive that hosted UI, so tests using this action group should assert on the order/OrderLink state created up to this point, then simulate the webhook side of the flow via RazorpaySimulateWebhookActionGroup rather than attempting to fill in the hosted modal.
